tools.name: check_site
tools.description: Runs the CT Web check-up on one public website and returns the findings: security (HTTPS, certificate, browser protections, outdated software, listing as a dangerous site), e-mail (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX), speed, domain name and DNS, cookies and legal pages, search visibility (including broken links,

tools.name: list_monitored_sites
tools.description: Needs an account token (Authorization: Bearer <token>, created by the account owner at https://ctweb.fr/compte). Lists the websites whose availability this CT Web account monitors, each with its state now (up, or down since when), its availability and its average response time over the last 24 hours

tools.name: get_site_monitoring
tools.description: Needs an account token (Authorization: Bearer <token>). For one site monitored by the account: availability, average response time, the outages of the period (start, end, cause, screenshot) and the response times point by point. Text in French.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_site" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
